title: Site search
summary: Site search in a window: a large rounded field and a separate results card under it over a light scrim, opened by a trigger or a key (Command/Control+K, /), a full-screen sheet on a phone. Results come from a provider (a port function) or a static JSON index, grouped, with scopes, recent and popular queries, quick actions and key hints, each block switchable.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

index.description: The address of a static JSON index (an array of entries, or {groups, items, popular}); the built-in provider reads it once and matches the query in it, case-insensitive. Not read when a provider is given

for.description: The id of a page element, or several separated by spaces, that opens the window when pressed; the trigger slot is the other way

shortcut.description: The keys that open the window, separated by spaces: mod is Command or Control (Command on a Mac, Control elsewhere; either works); a single printable key (/) acts only outside a text field; empty: none

label.description: The window's accessible name; «Поиск по сайту» / «Site search» in the page language when not set

placeholder.description: The field's placeholder; «Найти на сайте» / «Search the site» in the page language when not set

scopes.description: Filter pills over the results once there is a query: all, then one per result group, each with its count

recent.description: Recent queries on an empty field, each with a remove button, and a clear button; a query is recorded when one of its results is opened

recent-key.description: The name the recent queries are kept under, a view preference (SF.Preferences key sf-search/<recent-key>, in the browser localStorage sf-pref:sf-search/<recent-key>); give each search of a site its own; empty: kept for the page's life only

popular.description: Popular queries as pills on an empty field and under an empty result, from the data (popular)

actions.description: Results that run a command instead of opening a page (an action, with an optional shortcut hint): a quick actions group on an empty field and their own group among the results

path.description: The result's path as a second line under its title

keys.description: A footer with the keys: arrows to select, Enter to open, Escape to clear or close

provider.description: The results port: async function (query, {scope, signal}) answering {groups: [{id, label}], items: [{id, group, title, path, href | action, icon, shortcut}], popular: [text]}; called for the empty query too (quick actions and popular queries). A property only

open.summary: Opens the window with an empty field; refused when a page cancels sf-search-open

close.summary: Closes the window; refused when it is closed already or a page cancels sf-search-close

toggle.summary: Opens the window when it is closed and closes it when it is open

sf-search-open.summary: The window is about to open: a request a page may cancel

sf-search-opened.summary: The window opened and its field has focus

sf-search-close.summary: The window is about to close, and why: the field's close button or the back arrow (close), Escape on an empty field (escape), a press on the scrim (outside), or the action and a chosen result (api)

sf-search-navigate.summary: A result was chosen (Enter or a press): the window has closed and the query is recorded; a page that routes itself or runs the action cancels it, else the browser goes to href. An action result carries action and no href

keyboard: Command/Control+K, or / outside a text field, opens the window
ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the selection through the results; Enter opens the selected one
Escape clears the field, and on an empty field closes the window and gives focus back
accessibility.focus: The open window puts focus in its field, keeps Tab inside while it is the top layer and gives focus back to what had it (the trigger) when it closes.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-search for the site search of a SIMAI site or documentation: a window opened from a button in the header or by Command/Control+K, over a static index or the site's own search.
do_not: Do not draw a search window of your own on a SIMAI site
Do not put the results into the trigger slot; they come from the provider or the index
Do not handle Escape or the shortcut yourself; the component and the layer stack do
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-search index="/search-index.json"><sf-button icon-start="search" text="Поиск" appearance="tonal" scheme="on-surface" radius="rounded"></sf-button></sf-search>
